items.title: Malicious VSCode extensions on Microsoft's registry drop infostealers
items.description: Two malicious extensions on Microsoft's Visual Studio Code Marketplace infect developers' machines with information-stealing malware that can take screenshots, steal credentials, and hijack browser sessions. [...]

items.title: Apache Issues Max-Severity Tika CVE After Patch Miss
items.description: The Apache Software Foundation's earlier fix for a critical Tika flaw missed the full scope of the vulnerability, prompting an updated advisory and CVE.
